title: Cloud pool SSH disables host-key verification on credential upload (CE-02)
body:
From the 2026-10-10 codebase-health audit (CE-02, X-SEC-07). Not fixed by the remediation commits.

The Cloud pool SSH path disables host-key verification on the credential-upload channel: `crates/coder-cloud/src/pool.rs:343` passes `StrictHostKeyChecking=no`. A man-in-the-middle on that path can capture the credentials being uploaded.

## Fix

Pin host keys from GCE guest attributes into a per-host `known_hosts` and use `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` (or `accept-new` after first verified pin). Also validate identifiers before interpolating them into shell strings.

Related low-severity items in the same file: the key directory is created with the default umask (should be 0700) and the GCP project is hard-coded (CE-20).

Location: `crates/coder-cloud/src/pool.rs:337`.
